about: Composer image intent: the cases for apps/api/app/modules/images/{gen_intent,lookup_intent,intent}.py. phrases, threads and revision_contexts pin what the words find (a candidate: what to draw or look up); composer pins POST /images/intent, the verdict the chat turn and the phone's composer share once the turn's read has answered (read: image, photo or none; app/tests/modules/images/test_intent_contract.py). Only the read decides that a message asks for a picture: a case whose read says none gets none, whatever its words. The phone reads no intent: its prefilter test (features/images/model/__tests__/imageIntentPrefilter.test.ts) checks only that every case here the server draws or looks up is worth asking the server about.
